name: Aoki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aoki village emblem in navy: two interlocking outlined rings beneath a winged device.
history: Municipal flag of Aoki, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1974.

features.role: Aoki village emblem — two interlocking outlined rings beneath a winged device
